answer: Leather hides and beech boards cover the bellows-maker bench, cut to the pattern. Proof of bellows-maker via forge bellows tally — a bellows the bellows-maker folds only after 269 bellows blow true without one leaking at the fold, each folded by the bellows-maker himself. tundra glues the leather folds to the boards and presses flat. fable fits the brass nozzle and binds it fast with copper wire. signal works the handles and listens for a hiss at the seam. Two hundred and sixty-nine bellows must blow true without one leaking at the fold, and the next still leaks where the glue ran weak.
